notes.title: 3 Year Anniversary BORE DOME %TOTAL DISCOUNT%
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641942/358e7a5268b2ef214769e2410dfde6eebed223c3.gif[/img]

UPDATED DATES!! *

Since then, our beloved creation has reached people all over the world, in a way that we would have never imagined when working on it from our living room.

We want to thank everyone that has supported us through the years either by playing it, telling people about it, creating content about it, and buying the game: and in order to make this all the more easy, we present you with the ULTIMATE BORE DOME RELEASE ANNIVERSARY SALE:

📆 The sale will go on during weekend of the 4th-6th of JULY, starting FRIDAY 4th at 12.00am (CEST)  -  MONDAY 7th 12.00am (CEST) 📆

80% STEAM DISCOUNT means BORE DOME can be yours for the price of a coffee to be bored for the rest of eternity:
* Wait in a QUEUE
* FALL on the floor while trying to RUN
* CRY because the collapse of capitalism is scary and devastating
* ASK FOR A HELPING HAND to push towards nicer futures
* THINK beyond all the sentences that we wrote, beyond all the absurdly limited imagination of our current systems and most importantly:
* BE BORED, BE IMPERFECT

We love games for all the amazing things they can do, for their amazing flexibility as a medium, and for the insane collaborations they facilitate.

Celebrate with us the insane privilege to have been able to create something WEIRD for three years in this world obsessed with efficiency and profit.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEAM DISCLAIMER: Our Anniversary total sale is not possible on this platform without mediation from Valve. As this is not gonna happen, we offer you a great deal over here, but you are very welcome to [url=https://cargocollective.com/boredome]visit our webpage for extra info on our initial intent.[/url]

UPDATE DISCLAIMER: we basically did a random sale we couldn't cancel, and now there is a cooldown of 29days, that's the reason we are postponing the anniversary sale. 

🌈 We thank you for your understanding 🌈

notes.title: Shower Realism adjustments!
notes.content:
This small update contains some minor fixes, typos, and implements a functionality on the shower that some of you were very correctly asking for: The SHOWER DOME didn't affect you smelling like shit, and now it does! Shower for some time, and the SHIT smell dissapears!
